d: FAW Middle East Automible Trading FZE is a division of the Fortune 500 FAW China Group Corporation, we are a fast-growing automotive brand preparing our full-scale launch across Middle East and Africa, we are delightly to welcome new talents to join us from all over the world!

q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

r: Marketing Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned with business and sales targets.

d: Job Title: Senior Specialist Compliance and Governance

Riyadh Cables Group is the leading manufacturer of electrical wires and cables in the MENA region, offering innovative power transmission and communication solutions that fuel sustainable development. Our commitment to environmentally responsible practices and cutting-edge technology drives progress across infrastructure, energy, and industrial sectors.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our workforce with a dynamic environment that encourages growth, innovation, and sustainability.
q: 3–5 years of experience in compliance, corporate governance, internal controls, or equivalent.
Experience within a publicly listed (Tadawul / CMA-regulated) joint-stock company environment is strongly preferred.
Experience in manufacturing, industrial, energy, or infrastructure companies is preferred.
Experience with a Big 4 firm or another reputable governance, compliance, or risk advisory consultancy firm is preferred.
r: Supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of the Compliance and Corporate Governance framework across the company.

Responsible for monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and internal controls, supporting governance activities, identifying compliance gaps, and preparing reports and recommendations to strengthen the company’s compliance and governance practices.

The role supports the company’s obligations as a public joint-stock company listed on Tadawul and regulated by the CMA, in line with the CMA Corporate Governance Regulations and leading control frameworks such as the COSO Internal Control – Integrated Framework.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Corporate Governance, or equivalent.

Preferred professional certifications include Certified Compliance Officer; Certificate in Governance, Risk & Compliance; Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP); Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS); a recognized Corporate Governance / Board Secretary certification; CIA, or equivalent.
